attempts.notes: Fixed the reported type errors with minimal changes: byte-flag reads from store_f now cast through uint256 before uint8 and use == 0 / != 0 instead of !; comparisons against bytes storage use .length; uint256(store_e) cast for the totalSupply-style getter; bytes32 flag updates done in uint256 arithmetic then cast back; address-to-uint256 values cast via uint160; the string-typed name storage in Unresolved_c47f0027 is updated via a bytes copy (string/uint mixing was untypeable), and Unresolved_c23f85d6 returns bytes memory to match its packed return value. All function names, selectors' parameter types, errors and events are unchanged.

Fixed bytes32/uint constant division by casting store_f to uint256, wrapped storage masks in bytes32(...), replaced invalid !uint8(...) with == 0 checks, changed store_c/store_d to uint256 and the name variable to bytes so comparisons/assignments type-check, replaced address arithmetic with uint160/uint256 casts, gave all functions explicit return paths, and removed unreachable code after revert().
